Fibric Acid Derivatives lower triglyceride and raise HDL-C; can have a modest (about 6 percent)

Omega-3 fatty acids At doses of 2–4 g/day, omega-3 fatty acids lower triglyceride without sig­
nificant effects on LDL-C or HDL-C. There is mixed evidence regarding the cardioprotective effects 
of omega-3 fatty acids.
